articles.title: In Egypt, Guterres warns against Iran-US escalation

events.summary: UN Secretary-General António Guterres called for diplomacy and dialogue to end the ongoing war between the United States and Iran. His remarks were made to reporters during a visit to Cairo, Egypt.
events.why: Direct warfare between the US and Iran constitutes a severe risk to global energy security and international stability.

articles.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
Venezuelan opposition leader Machado returns from exile
Venezuela's opposition leader María Corina Machado returns after months in exile

events.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado returned from months of exile. Her return follows the US government's seizure of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.
events.why: The return of a primary opposition figure following the removal of Maduro indicates a dramatic and volatile shift in Venezuelan authority.

articles.title: Women and girls’ share of civilian war deaths doubles since 2021

events.summary: A major UN report revealed that women and girls accounted for one in four of the over 37,000 civilians killed in armed conflict last year. This figure represents a doubling of their share of civilian war deaths since 2021.
events.why: It documents a sharp demographic escalation in conflict lethality targeting vulnerable civilian populations worldwide.

articles.title: Lula wins fourth term in dramatic Brazil election comeback
Brazil's left-wing President Lula elected for fourth term

events.summary: Left-wing incumbent President Lula has won a fourth presidential term in Brazil. He achieved the comeback victory after initially trailing right-wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro in the first round.
events.why: The leadership of Latin America's largest democracy significantly shifts regional policy, environmental strategy, and global trade alliances.

articles.title: West Bank: Hebron crackdown displaces thousands, Türk warns of ethnic cleansing

events.summary: UN human rights chief Volker Türk warned of potential ethnic cleansing due to an aggressive Israeli operation in Hebron. The operation has displaced more than 3,000 Palestinians ahead of Israeli elections.
events.why: The mass displacement of civilians under military action risks permanent demographic alteration and broader regional conflict escalation.

articles.title: Celebrations in Serbia after veteran ruler Vučić loses election to student-led protest movement

events.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić conceded defeat after 12 years in power, losing an election to a student-led protest movement. Crowds celebrated the outcome of the vote, which had been characterized as a referendum on the country's future.
events.why: The defeat of an entrenched European leader by a grassroots movement marks a profound realignment in Balkan politics and governance.

articles.title: Brazil elections: Merz, world leaders congratulate Lula on his win
Brazil runoff as it happened: world leaders congratulate Lula on historic election win as Bolsonaro refuses to concede
‘Democracy always’: Lula vows no return to dictatorship in Brazil after election win
Brazil keeps left: what Lula’s victory means for his country and beyond

events.summary: World leaders congratulated Brazilian President Lula on winning re-election against far-right challenger Flávio Bolsonaro. Bolsonaro has refused to concede while Lula pledged that Brazil will not return to a dictatorship.
events.why: A disputed concession in Latin America's largest nation presents immediate risks to constitutional order and political stability.

articles.title: Ukraine: Investigators find Russia committed war crimes by targeting civilians

events.summary: Top human rights investigators reported that Russian authorities committed war crimes and crimes against humanity in Ukraine. The violations included attacking civilians and vital energy infrastructure.
events.why: Formal documentation of war crimes and crimes against humanity by international experts is critical for future legal accountability and international policy.

articles.title: Ebola: UN officials condemn killing of nurse in DR Congo

events.summary: UN officials and the WHO condemned the killing of a nurse responding to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The health worker was actively working to halt the spread of the disease.
events.why: Targeted violence against medical personnel directly undermines containment efforts for deadly epidemic outbreaks.

articles.title: Jordan arrests three suspects over deadly church attack
Jordan: 3 arrested over deadly church attack

events.summary: Jordanian authorities arrested three relatives in connection with a deadly attack on a church in Karak. The assault resulted in the deaths of eight people.
events.why: Lethal sectarian attacks threaten domestic stability and interfaith security in Jordan and the wider region.

articles.title: How 'Lula's Army' WhatsApp channel helped turn Brazil election around
How a WhatsApp channel helped Lula win Brazil’s election
How the streets and social media drove Lula to a historic comeback in Brazil

events.summary: A WhatsApp channel named 'Lula's Army' recruited millions of members during the Brazilian election. The platform converted online participation into physical mobilization to support Lula's campaign.
events.why: It illustrates the increasing tactical influence of private encrypted messaging networks on national electoral outcomes.

articles.title: Trump administration illegally fired James Comey's daughter, judge rules
US court rules daughter of Trump critic James Comey was illegally fired

events.summary: A US judge ruled that federal prosecutor Maurene Comey was unlawfully fired under the Trump administration. Comey stated her termination was motivated by her being the daughter of former FBI director James Comey.
events.why: The ruling reinforces protections against partisan political retaliation within the civil service and federal justice system.

articles.title: Why do planes keep circling before landing? UN has a plan to fix it

events.summary: The UN aviation agency is promoting a global coordination plan to reduce airborne flight circling and air traffic delays. The initiative aims to save billions in costs and reduce aviation emissions.
events.why: Optimizing international air traffic patterns offers measurable reductions in global fuel emissions and transportation expenditure.
